description: Persist a proposal for existing/new work items, planned or expedited crews, dependencies and aggregate limits. Starts nothing. Also requires studio:publish because orchestration can reach external systems. Open Code Studio to confirm the returned proposal; API/MCP arguments cannot attest human confirmation.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. Send the same key when retrying this exact call after a lost answer ("fetch failed"): the first call's result comes back and nothing is written twice. Reusing a key with different arguments is refused with idempotency_key_reused. 8-120 letters, digits, "_" or "-".
